240-1753-5470-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

822-2734-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
822-2734-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
822-2734-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2415-3641-3967.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3641-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1387-1500-2633-3940-7425.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {R}. Urabrask, Haze of Rage's storm ability, Blood Funnel and Prismari Pianist trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Prismari Pianist trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rage spells.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-4478-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
3259-4478-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1322-3259-7353.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have at least two creature cards in their graveyards.
1322-3259-7353.notablePrerequisites: Opponents with creature cards in their graveyards cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-7353.description:
Deal combat damage using Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached. Shark Shredder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Shark Shredder trigger, putting a creature card from the defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1322-3259-7353.notes: If there happens to be two or more creatures with haste in opponents' graveyards, you can omit Concordant Crossroads so long as both Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.

240-5231-5470-7297.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3986-6633.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
3259-3986-6633.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers. If needed, declare more creatures as attackers to ensure that the total power of attacking creatures is 6 or greater.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-4605-4681-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {5}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {5}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Karmic Guide and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1492-4195-4574-5849.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-4195-4574-5849.description:
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Welding Jar from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2173-2403-2448-5220.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2403-2448-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2167-5531-6621-6664.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
2167-5531-6621-6664.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.

222-3967-4871-5221.description:
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Sporuting Thrinax and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Sprouting Thrinax die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Sprouting Thrinax triggers once.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Sprouting Thrinax trigger, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Yahenni abilities from steps 1 and 5.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Sprouting Thrinax from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

116-5329-5399.notablePrerequisites:
Pirated Copy on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Pirated Copy do not have summoning sickness.
116-5329-5399.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Pirated Copy.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Pirated Copy.
Activate Pirated Copy by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Pirated Copy ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

803-1238-2034-2351-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Repeat.

570-3869-4067.notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness. There are at least four colors among permanents you control.
570-3869-4067.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.
570-3869-4067.notes: If you control a permanent of each color, this combo nets near-infinite mana in any combination of red, white and/or black.

2099-5365-5366.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue.
2099-5365-5366.description:
Activate Sarcatog's second ability by sacrificing the Clue.
Jenny Flint and Lonis' second ability trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Jenny Flint trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1558-3529-3668-4231.notablePrerequisites:
Flesh Duplicate is a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-3529-3668-4231.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

75-1429-4050.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
75-1429-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {B/G}.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Quillspike by paying {B/G} and removing the -1/-1 counter from Lesser Masticore, giving Quillspike +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

643-1322-1729-4696-5048.description:
Activate Meldweb Strider by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to any target and three damage to itself.
Meldweb Strider dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Shelob triggers, creating a token copy of Meldweb Strider that is a Food artifact.
Activate the Meldweb Strider token by removing an oil counter from it, causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Repeat.

2190-2390-3500-5299.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to place a counter on a permanent or player.
Basilisk Collar attached to All Will Be One.
2190-2390-3500-5299.description:
Place a counter on a permanent or player.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Vraska triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on All Will Be One.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Liliana, Heretical Healer // Liliana, Defiant Necromancer

136-2945-4050-5075.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cadaver Imp, adding {B}.
Cadaver Imp dies, triggering Ogre Slumlord and Liliana, Heretical Healer.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Liliana, Heretical Healer trigger, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield transformed, and creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Liliana, Defiant Necromancer's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it.
Liliana, Defiant Necromancer is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Liliana, Defiant Necromancer ability, returning Cadaver Imp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cadaver Imp enters the battlefield, returning Liliana, Heretical Healer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie and the Rat tokens, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Liliana, Heretical Healer by paying {1}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
